Leah (CS): Heads-up: GridFin asked if we can support their fraud-detection team and their new customer-engagement team. They expect ~2-3x chat token growth and embedding spikes for nightly re-index (~1.2M/day). Renewal in 3 months; said they'd consider dedicated if pricing is competitive.

Omar (AE): Any special compliance asks?

Nadia (Data): Fraud team needs low jitter and deterministic latency; they also want to store hashed PII only and need KMS. Customer-engagement wants lots of short sessions.

Leah (CS): Current baseline: avg QPS 180, p95 450ms, embeddings 75k/day. Projection: QPS 500, p95 target <200ms for fraud, embeddings 1.2M/day.

R&D-bot: Created ticket CS-3311: "GridFin expansion - latency SLAs + KMS checklist" assigned to Nadia.

Omar (AE): I'll get a cost delta and propose a phased approach (hosted + reserved embeddings then eval Dedicated). Can you get infra to estimate whether <200ms p95 is possible with caching + model choice?

Nadia (Data): I'll run some sims. Also suggest a short playbook for them on prefix caching and session pinning.

Leah (CS): Let's schedule 20-min runbook review Fri 9am PT. Omar will draft the renewal opportunity notes. :white_check_mark:
